parts.watchFor: Ilyas finds his people worshipping an idol. Watch what he asks them.

questions.q: What idol were Ilyas's people worshipping?
What did Ilyas ask his people?
options: Will you call on Ba'l and abandon the best of creators?

questions.q: How does the Quran describe Al-Yasa'?

lesson.text: Ilyas asked one clear question: why call on an idol and abandon the best of creators? Al-Yasa' carried the call on after him. God honours His prophets even when little of their story is told.
lesson.curious: Ilyas and Al-Yasa' are known in the Bible as Elijah and Elisha. The Quran honours them briefly, as part of the long line of prophets.

carry.title: A prayer for forgiveness and mercy

reflect.muslim: What do you turn to before God when things go wrong?
reflect.curious: What do people today rely on that can't really help them?

parts.act: When something goes wrong this week, make dua before you reach for anything else.

parts.watchFor: Yunus leaves his people in anger. Watch what he says in the darkest place on earth.

questions.q: Why did Yunus leave his city?
options: They would not listen, and he left in anger before God gave him leave

questions.q: What did Yunus call out in the darkness?
options: There is no god but You. Glory be to You! I have been one of the wrongdoers

questions.q: What happened to the city Yunus had left?
options: Everyone in it turned to God and believed

lesson.text: Yunus left too soon, and in the darkness of the whale he admitted it. God answered his call and saved him, and the whole city he had given up on believed. It's never too late to turn back to God, and never right to give up on people.
lesson.curious: Yunus is the biblical Jonah. Muslims treasure his prayer from inside the whale, and his city, the only one in the Quran that believed before punishment came.

reflect.muslim: Who have you given up on? What would turning back toward them look like?
reflect.curious: Have you ever walked away from something too soon? What happened?

parts.act: Say Yunus's prayer whenever you feel stuck or low this week.
